scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:live && npm run test:e2e:private
scripts.test:e2e:live: export OFFERS_LIVE=true; node scripts/build.mjs && (node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings tests/dev-server.ts ${PORT:-8888} >/dev/null 2>&1 & SERVER=$!; sleep 1; PORT=${PORT:-8888} node tests/e2e.mjs; CODE=$?; kill $SERVER; exit $CODE)
scripts.test:e2e:private: export OFFERS_LIVE=false; node scripts/build.mjs && (node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings tests/dev-server.ts ${PORT:-8889} >/dev/null 2>&1 & SERVER=$!; sleep 1; PORT=${PORT:-8889} node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings tests/e2e-private.mjs; CODE=$?; kill $SERVER; exit $CODE)
